networkDiscovery.notes: Chrome DevTools loaded the official market entry and listed its XHR/fetch requests. The browser did not automatically issue watchgrid because the page analytics request to rolexsaproductionh21l80g7.analytics.org.coveo.com failed with net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED; this is not a catalog failure. Chrome DevTools then made and read the official same-origin watchgrid request, and the official per-model price endpoint was independently observed from the product page network log.

primaryCollectionPath.pagination: A successful request with firstResult=0 and numberOfResults=1872 returned totalCount=1465 and 1465 results. A successful subsequent request with firstResult=1465 and numberOfResults=144 returned the same totalCount and an empty results array.

renderedCrossCheck.view: Official South Korea model view; no collection, size, material, or new-model filters
renderedCrossCheck.notes: The official rendered view exposed market-local product URLs and text. Full-list completion is established only by the saved structured response and terminal empty page; independent per-model price checks are recorded in validation-summary.json.
